title: Conflict
description: A single conflict page: neutral, sourced peace-building content. Real entries live in data/conflicts/<slug>.json, one per conflicts/<slug>.html page. Shared field formats are in defs.schema.json.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier matching the HTML file name under conflicts/, e.g. "northern-ireland".

title.description: Display title of the conflict, e.g. "Northern Ireland".

summary.description: Short, neutral overview of the conflict and its current peace-building status.

dateRange.description: Approximate active period of the conflict, if applicable.

start.description: Year or ISO date the conflict is generally considered to have started.

end.description: Year or ISO date it ended, or "ongoing".

regions.description: Countries or regions involved, as display names.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries involved.

initiatives.description: Concrete, verifiable peace-building initiatives, each attributable to an organisation and a source. Each one appears, with the same name and source URL, in the "Initiatives and organisations" list of the conflict page.

name.description: Exactly the text of the initiative's <strong> on the conflict page.

organisation.description: Name of the organisation running the initiative; should match an organisation.schema.json entry where one exists.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the initiative works in for this conflict.

type.description: What kind of initiative it is; drives the type filter on initiatives.html.

startYear.description: Year the initiative began (founded, launched or legally established). Drives the year filter on initiatives.html.

organisations.description: Optional list of organisation ids (see organisation.schema.json) active in this conflict.

actions.description: "What a reader can do today" — non-fundraising actions only (read, volunteer, share verified sources).

sources.description: Sources supporting the summary and initiatives, in the order of the page's Sources list.

neutralityReviewed.description: True once a contributor has confirmed the page uses neutral tone and contains no fundraising or advocacy language.

sourcesCheckedOn.description: ISO date when the page's external links were last validated, e.g. 2026-09-02. Must equal the page's "Sources last checked" line.
